items.title: Match the selector against the untruncated captured output and keep the stored receipt bounded separately
items.context: Compute selectorMatched from the full stripAnsi(output) before trimOutput; store outputTail as the LAST bounded window (or head plus tail) so the receipt stays small while the summary line remains visible. Keep the stripped-ANSI comparison and the exit-code rule unchanged.

items.title: Say in the refusal whether the output was truncated before matching
items.context: checklist.ts:808 refusal text should state captured/total bytes and whether the selector fell outside the retained window, so [receipt_selector_absent] never masquerades as a wrong selector (same discipline B-cdf6 applied to timeouts).

items.title: Regression: a command printing the selector after 12000 characters is accepted, and a command that never prints it is still refused
items.context: Add cases to the evidence receipt smoke (tool-executed-evidence-receipt-smoke or verification-run-and-guard-smoke) with a node -e script that emits 20000 filler characters then the selector.
